MAP WORKFLOW: open --grid, author regions.json, run --regions regions.json --inspect-map, inspect its crops, then correct the map. Stop here for a mapping-only task.
SCHEMA: comp-spec --schema lists required fields, coordinates, parentId and reviewGroup. Default inspection output is concise; --json prints the full report.
REGION COORDINATES: use one of grid (coarse inclusive cells), box {x,y,w,h} (fractions of the comp, 0..1), or pixelBox {x,y,w,h} (whole pixels in the original comp). Use exact bounds when an element ends inside a grid cell; do not include neighbouring content.
usage: impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --grid            write .impeccable/build/comp-grid.png (10x10 labeled grid) + palette + bands
       impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --regions <json>  measure regions -> .impeccable/build/spec.json
         regions json: { "regions": [ { "id": "art", "kind": "plate|image|texture|text|control|chrome", "grid": "E0:J4", "note": "..." } ] }
       impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --auto [--out f]  write a band draft; refine into elements before --regions
       impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --regions <json> --inspect-map [--out-dir dir] [--json]  inspect all crops and masks without writing a spec
       impeccable comp-spec --print                        the compact spec
       impeccable comp-spec --crop <id> [--out f] [--scale n]   reference crop of a region (never a shipping asset)
       impeccable comp-spec --plate-prompt <id> [--background transparent|opaque|auto]  the regeneration prompt for a raster region
